feature_name: Storage Transfer Service Resource Location Restriction enforcement
summary: Storage Transfer Service now enforces the Resource Location Restriction from Organization Policy Service to limit regions where transfer jobs can be created.
extended_definition: Storage Transfer Service now enforces the Resource Location Restriction from Organization Policy Service to limit regions where transfer jobs can be created.
